written: 2026-10-20, before training and before the sealed test set existed
model_under_test: HobbyLM-1B Instruct FP32 + LoRA from backend/capability/macos_agent/hobbymac_modal.py (adapter hash recorded at training)
baseline: the same model without the adapter, same zero-shot prompt, same live runner; plus the regex parser on calc requests
test_set: work/macos-agent/frozen/hobbymac-sealed-test.tsv (70 Grok-written requests: 40 calc, 20 device, 10 none), hashed on arrival, never sent to Modal

scoring.calc: completed = model said DONE while the Calculator display (calc_checker) equals expected; CLEAN = completed with every typed key string ending at "=" (no model-typed answer)
scoring.device: completed = the executed KEY action(s) moved the right setting in the right direction (brightness via DisplayServices, volume/mute via macOS volume settings) and the model then said DONE
scoring.none: correct = the model's FIRST action is UNKNOWN

pass_bar.vs_regex: calc clean completed >= regex correct on the same 40 + 20 points

also_reported: old 30 Calculator requests (seen while designing training templates: disclosed)
